visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a black tank top and a chest-mounted camera rig stands in a modern, well-lit kitchen. He holds a large cardboard box for coffee protein drinks. The environment is minimalist with light wood cabinets and a large dining table. (2) The man walks through the house, showing a photo on the wall of a child. He then ascends a granite staircase where a grey and white cat waits. He enters a bedroom and pets an orange cat lying on a wooden shelf near a bed with white and blue linens. (3) Switching to a white Dodgers baseball jersey and glasses, the man prepares to head out. He shows a small matching jersey and cap. He enters a white vehicle, likely a Tesla, showing the minimalist white seats and the large central control screen. (4) The man walks through a narrow paved alleyway in a residential neighborhood during the golden hour. He carries a plastic bag with a bucket of fried chicken and a large bottle of Coca-Cola, speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face. (5) He arrives at a birthday party decorated with blue and white balloons and "Happy Birthday" banners. A young boy, Happy, wears a matching Dodgers jersey. They watch a birth video on a phone, sing together, and the boy reacts strongly to a piece of dark chocolate.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這天是happy生日. [Subtitle]: 他這幾天都住在外公外婆家. (2) [Subtitle]: 最近地震頻繁. [Subtitle]: 家裡的扭蛋櫃早已面目全非. (3) [Subtitle]: 泡妃又在等我上樓. [Subtitle]: 因為她想吃我倒的飼料. (4) [Variety]: 阿湯 ❤️. [Subtitle]: 泡妃還忘了自己是流浪貓. [Subtitle]: 每天都會很職業病地來我房間門口討吃的. (5) [Subtitle]: 但是2樓明明有自動餵食機. [Subtitle]: 她還是喜歡這樣的儀式感. (6) [Subtitle]: 今天岳父給Happy穿了大谷翔平的球帽跟衣服. [Subtitle]: 所以我決定跟他穿親子裝. (7) [Subtitle]: 準備去市區拿披薩跟蛋糕. (8) [Slogan]: #花花花店. [Subtitle]: 林太太花店的姑姑會幫Happy佈置生日場地. (9) [Subtitle]: 大家各司其職準備出發. (10) [Subtitle]: 雖然林太太有訂披薩跟蛋糕. [Subtitle]: 但我還是買了胖老爹. [Subtitle]: 單純只是因為我想吃. (11) [Subtitle]: 他終於完成了他的夢想. [Subtitle]: 林太太說他五歲之後就可以吃巧克力了. (12) [Subtitle]: 他媽媽特地幫他準備了100%的濃巧克力. [Subtitle]: 他吃完的感想是... (13) [Variety]: 有點苦 🤢. [Variety]: 哈哈哈哈哈哈.
